programme.title: Ingenieros Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Nuestra evolución puede estar influenciada por nuestros antepasados y sus dioses. No estamos solos en el universo.

programme.title: Cíclope Extraterrestre: El Extraordinario Caso de la Sagrada Familia
programme.desc: En 1963 en Brasil, tres niños son testigos de un OVNI en su patio trasero. Un cíclope alienígena desciende y el Sr. Alberto investiga el fenómeno.

programme.title: El Incidente del Lago Falcon
programme.desc: Los extraterrestres visitan la Tierra a menudo; Destaca el incidente OVNI de 1967 en el lago Falcón de Canadá. Los frecuentes avistamientos de Canadá lo hacen enigmático.

programme.title: Diez Casos Antiguos de Alienígenas
programme.desc: Hay 10 casos increíbles de OVNIs, con personas que afirman tener hijos alienígenas, amistades con razas extraterrestres, habilidades telepáticas y vínculos con entidades alienígenas.

programme.title: Científicos Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Así como los humanos estudiamos la vida mediante muestras y cirugías, algunos informes sugieren que seres extraterrestres podrían observarnos igual. Mutilaciones de animales y abducciones apuntan a un extraño interés por la fauna terrestre.

programme.title: Cazadores De Ovnis: Los Ufólogos Italianos
programme.desc: Investigadores italianos exploran avistamientos masivos de ovnis, clipeología y testimonios reales, profundizando en la historia y los métodos de investigación de la ufología.

programme.title: En la Montaña de lo Desconocido: El Portal Alienígena
programme.desc: En los Alpes italianos, el Monte Musinè se alza envuelto en misterio. Leyendas de rituales antiguos, figuras míticas y avistamientos de OVNIs rodean este lugar, donde cuevas ocultas y sitios ancestrales mezclan realidad y mito.

programme.title: Roswell: La Verdad No Revelada
programme.desc: El comandante Jesse Marcel investiga extraños escombros encontrados en 1947, a pesar de que le dijeron que era un globo meteorológico.

programme.title: Alienígenas: Los Encuentros Esotéricos
programme.desc: Las historias teosóficas de Madame Blavatsky, los relatos sobre demonios Jinn, y la vida de Maria Orsic narran dimensiones en las cuales, a través de la espiritualidad y el esoterismo, es posible establecer contacto con alienígenas

programme.title: La Abducción de las Colinas: El Incidente Zeta Reticuli
programme.desc: Se explora el secuestro de Barney y Betty Hill y el incidente de Zeta reticuli.

programme.title: Extraterrestres contra la Guerra Nuclear: Edgar Mitchell
programme.desc: 12 caminantes lunares afirman que los extraterrestres visitaron la Tierra, el gobierno lo encubrió. Los extraterrestres detuvieron la guerra nuclear. ¿Loco o vale la pena escuchar más?

programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back, and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: The Island
programme.desc: In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: An eight-year-old Amish boy witnesses a drug-related murder in a Philadelphia train station. The Philadelphia police captain discovers that the murderers are cops trying to squelch a corruption investigation.

programme.title: Escape From Alcatraz
programme.desc: Frank Morris (Clint Eastwood), a hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz -- America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island.

programme.title: Nothing In Common
programme.desc: On his way up the corporate ladder, David Basner confronts his greatest challenge: his father.

programme.title: Running With Scissors
programme.desc: An adult man looks back on his childhood with his bipolar and self-centered mother.

programme.title: Relative Chaos
programme.desc: Three siblings compete in a challenges to determine the winner of the family cup for the following year.

programme.title: Funny Girl
programme.desc: In this bittersweet, classic musical drama, the vibrant and beautiful young Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) starts out as a bit player on the New York City vaudeville stage, but works her way up to stardom on Broadway. Valued for her vocal and comedic talents by the renowned theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld (Walter Pidgeon), Fanny thrives, but her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nick Arnstein (Omar Sharif), is another story.

programme.title: Oliver!
programme.desc: In this award-winning adaptation of the Broadway musical based on the Charles Dickens novel, 9-year-old orphan Oliver Twist (Mark Lester) falls in with a group of street-urchin pickpockets led by the Artful Dodger (Jack Wild) and masterminded by the criminal Fagin (Ron Moody). When Oliver's intended mark, Mr. Brownlow (Joseph O'Conor), takes pity on the lad and offers him a home, Fagin's henchman Bill Sikes (Oliver Reed) plots to kidnap the boy to keep him from talking.

programme.title: It Happened One Night
programme.desc: In Frank Capra's acclaimed romantic comedy, spoiled heiress Ellie Andrews impetuously marries the scheming King Westley, leading her tycoon father to spirit her away on his yacht. After jumping ship, Ellie falls in with cynical newspaper reporter Peter Warne, who offers to help her reunite with her new husband in exchange for an exclusive story. But during their travels, the reporter finds himself falling for the feisty young heiress.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It's free, he's got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Honeymooners
programme.desc: Bus driver Ralph Kramden and sanitation engineer Ed Norton are best friends who dream of making it big. Their most recent “get-rich-quick” plan finds the boys out to make their fortune by hiring a dog trainer to race their pet greyhound.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Wallace, who is burned out from a string of failed relationships, forms an instant bond with Chantry, who lives with her longtime boyfriend. Together, they puzzle out what it means if your best friend is also the love of your life.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon, George Gruntz, Guy Pedersen & Daniel Humair
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 & '64 features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others. One of the most influential saxophonists in jazz history, Dexter Gordon is captured in sharp form and style in this 70-minute tour de force.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette, Howard Johnson, Greg Osby & John Purcell
programme.sub-title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007. His style combines elements of jazz, free jazz, world music and R & B, and his versatility makes him a regarded and in-demand drummer. Discover his unique style as part of this breathtaking performance delivered at Estival.

programme.title: Sir John Eliot Gardiner & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian', and Edward Elgar's Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. Written in 1872, Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 bears the nickname ‘Little Russian', as the composer used folk tunes in his work from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. Completed in 1899, Elgar's Enigma Variations is an orchestral work comprising a theme and fourteen variations, each variation being a musical sketch of one of the composer's friends. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they'd never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: Peacock
programme.desc: John Skillpa, a quiet bank clerk living in tiny Peacock, Nebraska, prefers to live an invisible life. This might have to do with John's secret: he has another personality no one knows about, a woman who each morning cooks him breakfast before he starts his day. Then, in a moment, everything changes.

programme.title: Love Sarah
programme.desc: Three generations of women, led by Mimi will need to overcome grief, doubts and differences to honour the memory of their beloved Sarah, while embarking on a journey to establish a new bakery in Notting Hill, a place filled with love, hope and colourful pastries from all over the world.

programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: As Aria gets ready for the yearly Masters of Chocolate Festival, things take a turn when her partner quits just before the big event. But soon, a charming single dad comes to her rescue, helping her discover the secret to winning.

programme.title: Somewhere Tomorrow
programme.desc: A teenage girl sees a plane crash and ends up chatting with one of the injured passengers, but later discovers that he was already dead from the crash.

programme.title: BMX Bandits
programme.desc: A trio of teen BMX enthusiasts become entangled with a group of bank robbers after discovering their cache of walkie-talkies.

programme.title: The Man with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: A junkie must face his true self to kick his drug addiction.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: Mads Mikkelsen stars as a pilot whose plane has crashed in a remote corner of the Arctic. Stranded in the wilderness he uses his ingenuity to survive. But he is forced to make a perilous choice between the safety of his camp and a trek into the unknown.

programme.title: Curse of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: Inspector Clouseau is missing and the Pink Panther (David Niven) is hot on his trail in this wildly funny laugh-fest that offers plenty of slapstick humor and a myriad of stars including Joanna Lumley, Herbert Lom and Robert Wagner.

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: The memories and skills of a deceased CIA agent are implanted into a dangerous convict.

programme.title: Draft Day
programme.desc: With the NFL draft approaching, the Browns GM faces tough decisions and a complicated personal life.

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: A dying CIA agent is offered an experimental drug that could save his life in exchange for one last assignment

programme.title: The Claus Family
programme.desc: After discovering his grandfather is Santa Claus, Jules has to help him deliver his presents all around the world. But Jules' hatred for Christmas might make that more difficult than Santa thought.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: Christmas Miracle (2014)
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve in the sleepy town of Rockford when Sheriff Rick Langston (Dean Cain, Lois & Clarke: The New Adventures of Superman) arrests a mysterious man who resembles Santa Claus. However, when the townspeople's Christmas wishes all start to come true, the sheriff begins to wonder if this jolly old man just might be the real deal. It is when he is out of love and luck and at his most cynical that the sheriff meets Lucy (Christine Lakin, Valentine\s Day) and is shown the miracle of love and family. As Christmas Day fast approaches, new relationships are forged and existing ties are strengthened in this uplifting festival story for the whole family.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: Phoenix Forgotten
programme.desc: In search of answers to the unusual events in their Arizona town, three teens went into the desert hoping to document the incident. They disappeared that night and were never seen again. Now, on the 20th anniversary of their disappearance, unseen footage has finally been discovered, chronicling the final hours of their fateful expedition. From Producer Ridley Scott (The Martian, Prometheus) and based on the shocking, true events of March 13th, 1997, when several mysterious lights appeared over Phoenix, Arizona. This unprecedented and inexplicable phenomenon became known as The Phoenix Lights, and remains the most famous and widely viewed UFO sighting in history.

programme.title: Lucky Grandma
programme.desc: A dark comedy full of heart, laughs and wicked sass. The story of a cardigan clad, chain smoking Chinese Grandma who in an attempt to get some cash goes all in at a casino but lands herself on the wrong side of luck. When she steals loot from a dead criminal boss, she hires a rival gangland bodyguard to protect her from the violent crooks who are after her to reclaim the cash.

programme.title: Ideal Home
programme.desc: Paul Rudd and Steve Coogan -the kings of comedy come together for this must-see film. A big screen match made in heaven in this poignant and endearing comedy as they play a bickering, and flamboyant, couple (with an extensive erotic film collection) whose lavish life is thrown in to turmoil with the sudden appearance of their long-lost grandson. Will the pair be able to take on this new challenge?

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Starring Morgan Freeman and John Cusack comes a twisty, slick and intelligent crime thriller full of action, suspense mystery and intrigue. Cusack plays Ray Keene, a father who, during a hiking trip with his son in the wilderness, is suddenly forced into a dangerous rescue mission when a notorious assassin, Frank Cordell, washes downriver handcuffed to a dying US Marshall.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Academy Award® winner Russell Crowe stars as Noah, a man chosen by God for a great task before an apocalyptic flood destroys the world.

programme.title: The Railway Man
programme.desc: Eric Lomax was one of thousands of Allied prisoners of war forced to work on the construction of the Thai/Burma railway during WW2. Years later, he met Patti and fell in love. Discovering that the young Japanese officer who haunted her husband was still alive, she faced a terrible decision.

programme.title: Meet Me in New York
programme.desc: Kelly is a young, creative, ambitious events planner in New York City and quickly gaining a reputation as one of the best in the business. But when Joe, an influential website editor, hires her to organize his niece's 10th birthday party, Kelly quickly realizes that she may have just met her match.

programme.title: Listen Out for Love
programme.desc: Peyton Pepper, a goal-driven podcast producer, is forced to mold Alex McKinney, a brash loose cannon, into her next star and create the perfect show to save both of their careers. That show comes in the form of finding Peyton's iconic idol, true love.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: Jenny Farrell has led an openly gay life - except with her conventional family. When she finally decides to start a family and marry the woman they thought was just her roommate, the small, safe world the Farrells inhabited changes forever.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: When Seattle interior designer Lily Summers returns to her hometown to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast, she meets Marcus, the handsome seaplane pilot whose life's work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

programme.title: Comet
programme.desc: Comet explores the six-year relationship between Dell and Kimberly, as it skips around between five pivotal moments.

programme.title: Christmas in Mississippi
programme.desc: Photographer Holly returns to Gulfport, Mississippi for Christmas. Their traditional holiday light show has been revived again since a hurricane struck five years earlier. She is shocked to learn the festival is run by her high school sweetheart, Mike.

programme.title: Falling in Love at Christmas
programme.desc: Miranda and Paul, two rivals, meet on a costumed Santa crawl and spend a romantic evening together without learning each other's identities. As their anonymous romance continues online, their businesses merge, forcing them into an unwanted partnership.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina moves into her friend's suite at The Chesterton Hotel as she waits for her divorce settlement to come through on Christmas Day. While there, she starts a whirlwind romance with a billionaire, who proposes to her.

programme.title: My Best Friends Christmas
programme.desc: When Ashley's plans to reconnect with her high school sweetheart over Christmas fails, she and her best friend Liam decide to fake their own romance. But as her feelings start to turn real, Ashley will have to decide what her heart really wants.

programme.title: A Christmas to Savour
programme.desc: Scarlett is a chef but every year her holiday dishes never sell. So this year, her best friend buys her a ticket for a holiday...maybe she will find love in a handsome rival chef from her past, and regain the Christmas spirit.

programme.title: Love On Harbor Island
programme.desc: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

programme.title: Lost in Love
programme.desc: Two tourists in Turkey get left behind by their tour bus after visiting an archaeological site. Without their belongings, they must make their way back to Istanbul, improvising along the way with meager means.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: A runaway bride does some soul-searching when she's trapped in a snowed-in cabin with her grandmother and an old flame at Christmas.

programme.title: Miracle Maker
programme.desc: “The Miracle Maker is coming!” If any town is in need of a miracle, it's Woodhaven, a tiny town hanging on the edge of the American frontier. It's nearly Christmas, but it's hardly a season of celebration. Work is scarce, money is tight, love is lagging, and spirits are down. Maybe the Miracle Maker can turn things around. The town anxiously waits for someone magnificent who can change their lives. But the ragged traveler who appears isn't what anyone expects—except for one small silent boy and a precocious little girl. It seems this man can barely take care of himself, let alone fulfill the dreams of others. But miracles can come in all shapes and sizes—and sometimes from unexpected places. Your entire family will love this Christmas tale of hope, love, and miracles.

programme.desc: An interior designer trying to save her home renovation show needs to apply her successful, upscale "fixer upper" home renovation strategy to her blue collar carpenter by making the sweet but disheveled guy her next fixer upper project.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon, George Gruntz, Guy Pedersen & Daniel Humair
programme.desc: Dexter Gordon: Live in '63 & '64 features three concerts filmed in Holland, Switzerland, and Belgium that highlight the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. These shows feature legendary side musicians such as Art Taylor (drums) and Kenny Drew (piano), and jazz classics “Blues Walk”, “A Night In Tunisia”, “Body And Soul”, and others. One of the most influential saxophonists in jazz history, Dexter Gordon is captured in sharp form and style in this 70-minute tour de force.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: Art Farmer
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Jack DeJohnette, Howard Johnson, Greg Osby & John Purcell
programme.sub-title: Jack DeJohnette's Special Edition at Estival 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jack DeJohnette, an important figure in jazz fusion, was inducted into the Modern Drummer Hall of Fame in 2007. His style combines elements of jazz, free jazz, world music and R & B, and his versatility makes him a regarded and in-demand drummer. Discover his unique style as part of this breathtaking performance delivered at Estival.

programme.title: Sir John Eliot Gardiner & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian', and Edward Elgar's Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. Written in 1872, Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 bears the nickname ‘Little Russian', as the composer used folk tunes in his work from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. Completed in 1899, Elgar's Enigma Variations is an orchestral work comprising a theme and fourteen variations, each variation being a musical sketch of one of the composer's friends. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Kazuki Yamada & Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse
programme.desc: 2024 marks the 100th anniversary of Gabriel Fauré's death. He is considered one of the most important and influential composers, having been the teacher of Maurice Ravel, Georges Enescu, Nadia Boulanger and many others. The Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse and The Philharmonic Chorus of Tokyo, with Florian Sempey as soloist, perform Gabriel Fauré's Requiem in the Basilique de Saint-Sernin in Toulouse, the largest surviving Romanesque church in France and one of the most important buildings in Romanesque architecture. This extraordinary concert is conducted by Kazuki Yamada, who is currently one of the most exciting young maestros. In spring 2023, he was appointed Principal Conductor and Artistic Advisor of the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra, and is also Artistic and Musical Director of the Orchestre Philharmonique de Monte-Carlo.

programme.title: Tim Weiss, Arctic Philharmonic, Berit Norbakken Solset & Øystein Moen
programme.sub-title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström' (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe's short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story. The piece was performed at the Adelaide Festival of Arts in 1986. Beacon Isle Films recorded an arrangement of Glass's work for symphony orchestra, performed by the Arctic Philharmonic Orchestra and Choir conducted by Tim Weiss. Soprano Berit Norbakken Solset is the soloist. The Artic Philharmonic Orchestra is the world's youngest and northernmost professional orchestral institution, presenting circa 150 performances and concerts each year. This 2019 recording was made against the backdrop of Lofoten's spectacular landscape: the very surroundings that inspired Poe's story.

programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-'nérd ‘Skin-'nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Zoe
programme.desc: Dos compañeros en un revolucionario laboratorio diseñan la tecnología que mejora y perfecciona relaciones románticas. Mientras su trabajo progresa, sus descubrimientos se hacen más profundos.

programme.title: Algo prestado
programme.desc: La vida de Rachel se complica cuando acaba celebrando su treinta cumpleaños acostándose con el prometido de su mejor amiga. Divertida comedia romántica protagonizada por Kate Hudson

programme.title: Algún día nos lo contaremos todo
programme.desc: Verano de 1990, antigua Alemania Oriental. María está a punto de cumplir 19 años y vive en la granja de los padres de su novio Johannes...

programme.title: The Navigator: Una odisea en el tiempo
programme.desc: Para salvar a un poblado medieval de la peste negra, un niño visionario encabeza, junto a cinco hombres, un viaje ingenuo y fantástico a través de un túnel hacia el centro de la Tierra hasta llegar, desde la Inglaterra del siglo XIV donde se encuentran, a la Nueva Zelanda del siglo XX.

programme.title: Norman, el hombre que lo conseguía todo
programme.desc: Norman es un hombre de negocios de poca monta que vive en Nueva York. Parece que todos lo conocen pero en realidad nadie sabe nada de él. Un día por casualidad, hace un favor a un joven político que unos años más tarde se convierte en un líder mundial influyente. La vida de Norman cambiará radicalmente.

programme.title: Detective Dee y el misterio de la llama fantasma
programme.desc: Con motivo de la pronta ascensión al trono de Wu Zetian, la que será primera emperatriz de China, en la capital se construye una enorme estatua de Buda. Cuando unos dignatarios sufren una misteriosa muerte por combustión espontánea, Wu recaba la ayuda del detective Dee Renjie, un oficial al que encarceló varios años antes por traidor, para que resuelva el misterio.

programme.title: Super Mario Bros
programme.desc: Mario y Luigi son dos fontaneros de Brooklyn que deben viajar a otra dimensión para rescatar a la princesa Daisy de las garras…

programme.title: Cortes Peligrosos
programme.desc: Cuatro estilistas de Dublin se convierten en justicieras accidentales y héroes de la comunidad.

programme.title: El Poder de un Sueño
programme.desc: El joven Abe engaña a su tío alcohólico (Malkovich) para que compre un barco a un estafador.

programme.title: Charlie & Boots
programme.desc: Padre e hijo viajan para cumplir su ambición de toda la vida: pescar en el extremo norte de Australia.

programme.title: Barbaque
programme.desc: Un carnicero mata por accidente a un activista vegano y vende su carne... con un éxito inesperado.

programme.title: A la de Tres
programme.desc: Val y Kevin deciden ayudarse a morir, pero antes tendrán un último día para cerrar asuntos pendientes.

programme.title: Los becarios
programme.desc: Billy y Nick son dos comerciales cuyas carreras se han visto bombardeadas por el mundo digital. Intentando demostrar que no están obsoletos, desafiarán cualquier pronóstico logrando hacerse un hueco como becarios en Google, junto con un batallón de universitarios jóvenes y brillantes.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Con 2 nominaciones a los Globos de Oro y con un trío cómico protagonista impecable, 'St. Vincent' cuenta la historia de un chico cuyos padres se acaban de divorciar. La situación no es sencilla para él, le cuesta aceptar la nueva realidad. Sin embargo, las cosas cambian cuando conoce a su vecino.

programme.title: El club de las madres solteras
programme.desc: Cuando cinco madres solteras luchadoras apartan sus diferencias para formar un grupo de apoyo, encuentran la inspiración y la risa en su nueva hermandad, y se ayudan unas a otras a superar los obstáculos a los que se enfrentan.

programme.title: En qué piensan los hombres
programme.desc: Cuatro amigos conspiran para revertir la situación con sus mujeres cuando descubren que han estado usando los consejos sobre relaciones de Steve Harvey contra ellos.

programme.title: Una Novata en un Cuento de Hadas
programme.desc: La historia de Blancanieves se adapta a los tiempos modernos, con estudiantes de primero en una universidad con hermandades.

programme.title: Click (2006)
programme.desc: Un hostigado adicto al trabajo, Michael Newman (Adam Sandler) no tiene tiempo para su esposa (Kate Beckinsale) e hijos, y tampoco para impresionar a su ingrato jefe y ganarse un ascenso bien merecido. Así que cuando conoce a Morty (Christopher Walken), chiflado vendedor, recibe la respuesta a todas sus oraciones: un control remoto mágico que le permite evitar las pequeñas distracciones de la vida con resultados para morirse de la risa. Pero mientras Michael alegremente silencia, salta o escanea los momentos familiares y con sus amigos, el control gradualmente toma control sobre su vida y empieza a programarlo, en esta rápida, hilarante y alocada aventura cómica.

programme.title: El cuatrero errante
programme.desc: El hermano se enfrenta al hermano en esta historia de rancheros enfrentados en el viejo oeste.

programme.title: Sitting Bull: Casta de guerreros
programme.desc: Sitting Bull, líder de los Sioux, se ve obligado por el general Custer a reaccionar violentamente, lo que lleva a la famosa batalla en Little Bighorn. Parrish, un amigo de los Sioux, intenta evitar la sangre derramada pero es acusado de colaborar con el enemigo. Sitting Bull intercede ante el presidente Grant para salvarlo.

programme.title: 30 Winchester para El Diablo
programme.desc: El líder de los bandidos El Diablo, que controla el país con su banda, planea conseguir oro destinado a México, pero no es el único.

programme.title: Más muerto que vivo
programme.desc: Liberado de la prisión después de 18 años, el famoso pistolero 'Killer' Cain es ahora, un hombre pacífico y reformado pero el Viejo Oeste ha muerto y no puede adaptarse al Oeste moderno donde algunas deudas morales sin pagar y viejos problemas resurgen.

programme.title: Código Eterno
programme.desc: Dos empresas desarrollan la tecnología de la vida eterna (transferencia de la mente a un nuevo cuerpo). La resistencia a la fusión de las 2 empresas se enfrenta con secuestros y asesinatos.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y el tesoro perdido de Ugarit
programme.desc: Jack Hunter, arqueólogo, debe robar una tablilla de un museo en Francia y viaja a Damasco tras el asesinato de su amigo. Junto a Nadia y Tariq, enfrenta peligros de Albert Littman y descubre secretos mientras sigue la pista de la reliquia codificada de Ugarit.

programme.title: Jack Hunter y la búsqueda de la tumba de Akhenaten
programme.desc: Jack Hunter es secuestrado por la NSA para buscar la otra parte del arma de Osiris en Giza. Junto a Lena y sus amigos sirios, enfrenta a una secta midianita, a un coronel ambicioso y a peligros mortales mientras descifra pistas ugaríticas hacia el tesoro de la tumba del faraón.

Gabriel, un profesor de filosofía y lógica en la escuela nocturna, se verá inmerso en tratar de entender el significado de los dibujos proféticos de Benjamín Solari Parravicini, un artista argentino que predijo el evento del 11-S del WTC en 1939, y otros eventos históricos.

programme.title: Un golpe a la inglesa
programme.desc: XXX (Matthew Goode) es un delincuente profesional con muchos contactos. Tras pasar tres años a la sombra por robar una casa victoriana londinense,sale de la cárcel con nuevas amistades y un plan: robar el depósito de seguridad de Hatton Garden, el barrio de las joyerías de Londres. En cuanto salta el rumor de que se está planeando dar el golpe del siglo, Marcus Ford (Stephen Moyer) recurre a un antiguo inspector jefe de Scotland Yard con un pasado corrupto en busca de información. Marcus quiere recuperar el contenido de una de las cajas de seguridad antes de que caiga en las manos equivocadas.

programme.title: Espiando a los detectives
programme.desc: Un cinéfilo aficionado al cine negro en extremo prueba de su propia medicina y ve cómo su vida da un vuelco de la mano de una extraña mujer fatal con una gran aventura en mente. A veces el amor supera a la ficción.

programme.title: Zeros and Ones
programme.desc: JJ (Ethan Hawke), un soldado norteamericano destinado en Roma, ve saltar por los aires la ciudad del Vaticano a plena noche. Así se embarcará en un heroico viaje para descubrir y enfrentarse a un enemigo desconocido que está amenazando al mundo entero. Pero ¿qué papel jugará en todo esto su hermano, un radical revolucionario que se encuentra en búsqueda y captura?

programme.title: Prácticamente muerto
programme.desc: Clahan es un sacerdote protestante que dirige a un grupo de fanáticos de la supremacía blanca. Un día, durante un sermón, es asesinado por un extremista de izquierdas. Su inconsolable viuda, dispuesta a vengarse, busca la ayuda de dos fanáticos, que secuestran y torturan a un hombre al que creen culpable.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: Frontera
programme.desc: Un grupo de teatro ensaya una versión de 12 hombres sin piedad cuando los interrumpe una alarma. Nos encontramos dentro de la prisión de Quatre Camins y la señal indica el aislamiento de los módulo.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: El pomo azul
programme.desc: Soledad, que forma una pareja aparentemente consolidada con Juan, busca el piso más apropiado para su futuro en común.

programme.title: El invierno de las anjanas
programme.desc: Adelaida pierde a su novio Eusebio en la Guerra de Cuba. Al no asumir la ausencia de Eusebio, la joven es ingresada en un sanatorio para enfermos mentales. En su reclusión, Adelaida rememora los recuerdos de su vida con Eusebio...

programme.title: Anabel
programme.desc: Tras la marcha, en circunstancias algo turbias, de Anabel, sus dos compañeras de piso deben buscar a alguien más con quien compartir el alquiler. El elegido es un señor mayor que logra ganarse su confianza, pero que pronto se descubrirá como una presencia extraña e inquietante.

programme.title: Asylum Seekers
programme.desc: A freewheeling demented comedy about the modern world, in which six people, fed up with the abuse they suffer in their normal lives, seek asylum ... as inmates of a mental institution. The only problem is, there's just one bed available.

programme.title: La Rapina a Pineville
programme.desc: Un adolescente delle superiori si imbatte nelle conseguenze di una rapina in banca andata storta e si ritrova rinchiuso nella sua scuola cercando di mantenere in vita se stesso e il suo insegnante mentre uno dei rapinatori psicotici li dà la caccia.

programme.title: Afterlife
programme.desc: Paul Perry ponders the question 'what happens when we die?' through a series of interviews with subjects who have had near-death experiences.

programme.title: Las Escrituras de la Muerte
programme.desc: Shannon es la encargada de restaurar una mansion victoriana. Las renovaciones van perfectamente hasta que el jefe del banco local es encontrado muerto.

programme.title: Molly TV Cut
programme.desc: A girl living alone in a post apocalyptic wasteland finds herself hunted down by marauders who want her to fight in their fighting pit for their entertainment.

programme.title: Asalto a Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim, un neoyorquino corriente, vive con una esposa enferma pero cariñosa. De repente, todo cambia cuando la economía se hunde y lo pierde todo. Lleno de ira y rabia, Jim se propone vengarse de la vida que le han arrebatado.

programme.title: Los Supervivientes
programme.desc: Samuel, un hombre que vive en los Alpes italianos, decide ayudar a Chehreh, una mujer afgana, a llegar a Francia. Tendrán que enfrentarse a una naturaleza hostil y a la crueldad de los hombres que habitan este territorio.

programme.title: Kickboxer 4: El agresor
programme.desc: Sasha Mitchell (Kickboxer 2 y 3) regresa triunfalmente al ring como David Sloan, luchando no solo por su supervivencia, sino también por su bella esposa, quien se ha convertido en la prisionera sexual del despreciable campeón mundial, Tong Po. Incriminado, olvidado y furioso, Sloan se ha consumido en prisión, pero los federales acceden a liberarlo si logra entrar en la impenetrable fortaleza mexicana de Tong Po, protegida por sus letales guardias y adornada por sus esclavas sexuales. Sloan no tiene más remedio que participar en el torneo de campeones de Po, una batalla salvaje donde el ganador se lo lleva todo, ¡y para Sloan eso significa todo! A regañadientes, forma alianzas con algunos otros para ayudarlo.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio en Los Ángeles y luego uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: Código fuente
programme.desc: ¿Es posible viajar en el tiempo para evitar una catástrofe? El capitán Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) tiene la difícil misión de conseguirlo en esta eficaz película de acción y ciencia-ficción considerada como una de las mejores películas del género de los últimos años.

programme.title: Comando War Pigs
programme.desc: Al Capitán de la Segunda Guerra Mundial Jack Wosick, se le da la oportunidad de redimirse cuando se le designa para dirigir una unidad variopinta de soldados inadaptados conocidos como los “War Pigs”.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: A un agente especial estadounidense caído en desgracia (John Cusack) se le encarga la rutinaria misión de proteger a una joven civil (Malin Akerman), cifradora de códigos de defensa, en una estación emisora secreta en Gran Bretaña.

programme.title: Dead Man Down (La venganza del hombre muerto)
programme.desc: Espectacular historia de venganza en forma de frenético thriller sobre dos personas obsesionadas y heridas por el pasado, la mano derecha de un mafioso (Colin Farrell) y una misteriosa mujer víctima de un crimen, que juntos llevarán a cabo un oscuro y violento plan de venganza.

programme.title: Sharknado 5: Aletamiento Global
programme.desc: Con gran parte de América del Norte en ruinas, el resto del mundo se prepara para lo inevitable.

programme.title: Cuestión de honor
programme.desc: Un Ranger del Ejército se infiltra en una familia mafiosa haciéndose pasar por asesino a sueldo.

programme.title: Ashfall
programme.desc: El volcán Baekdu despierta y Corea del Sur y del Norte deberán unir fuerzas para detenerlo.

programme.title: Infalible

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: ¡Vuelven Los Cazafantasmas! Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis y Sigourney Weaver. Son los auténticos cazadores de seres sobrenaturales, los únicos que pueden salvar al mundo de la fantasmagórica plaga que se extiende por todo el planeta. Ya han llegado a New York. La estatua de la libertad está en peligro.

programme.title: The Dark Tower (2017)
programme.desc: Un mundo moribundo. Un paisaje del viejo oeste, donde el tiempo no corre de forma normal, donde ciudades y regiones enteras desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. El Pistolero Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), último miembro de una orden de caballería denominada los Pistoleros, inicia la búsqueda de un edificio mitológico conocido como La Torre Oscura. Según cuenta la leyenda, esta torre es el centro de convergencia de todos los universos.
